title: Delegated PRs merge on a thorough required CI gate with owner-gated exceptions
acceptance: AGENTS.md states the owner's standing grant: agents branch, commit, push and open a PR; each merge needs the owner's permission for that PR (asked in chat, or by PR comment plus ready-to-merge), then a final code review and squash-merge only if it finds nothing significant. Deploys, deletion and applying owner-approved on the agent's own judgment stay ungranted.
The required CI job fails a PR touching owner-gated paths unless it carries owner-approved, and its own tests run first and have been watched failing.
The required CI job runs the Playwright e2e smoke and uploads per-page screenshots as an artifact, green on Linux on the PR's final head.
agent-prompts/delegate-task.md and .github/pull_request_template.md give a hand-off brief and PR evidence sections, linked from the prompt index, README and CLAUDE.md.
Codex's RF-97 session corrections are carried forward intact and point at the standing grant.

evidence.summary: 4/4 pass locally; two deliberate mutations (dropping the AGENTS.md gate, forcing pass) each failed 3/4. Dry run against PR #641's real file list failed without the label and passed with it.
pnpm e2e passed 2/2 (desktop-1440, phone-390) in 16s on macOS with 10 screenshots after installing Chromium. Superseded for Linux by the GitHub Actions entry below.
Work PR, opened as a draft to claim the task. Owner-gated (needs-owner). The ci.yml commit was pushed after the owner granted the workflow scope.

GitHub Actions on Linux for bfc2622: all steps passed including RF-trace, D1 integration, build, Playwright e2e (10 screenshots uploaded as e2e-screenshots); the final owner-gate step failed as designed because #643 touches owner-gated paths and lacks owner-approved.

Owner revised the merge rule mid-review on 2026-10-27: every PR asks permission before a final code review and squash-merge; findings stop the merge; background agents ask with a PR comment and the ready-to-merge label. Folded into #643 before merge.

resolution: Standing delegation grant (revised by the owner on 2026-10-27 to ask before each final review and merge), owner gate and e2e smoke are in the required CI job. On GitHub Linux every check passed (first full pass: run 40610775187 on bfc2622; the final head's run is on #643), including the Playwright smoke at 1440 and 390 with a 10-screenshot artifact; the owner gate, run last, correctly failed this owner-gated PR pending owner-approved. Merging #643 publishes this; deployment is not involved.
